# César Gómez — Senior Vue/Nuxt · AI-Assisted Craft

> Portfolio for César Gómez (mrcego / Cesar Gomez): senior fullstack developer with a frontend focus, 13+ years with Vue 3, Nuxt 4, TypeScript, and maintainable delivery. Based in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia. Remote contract from August 2026.

Last reviewed: 2026-07-31

- Senior Vue/Nuxt developer — not an AI Engineer, NLP Engineer, or LLM Engineer

- Node.js/Express for typed APIs; Django/Python backend work at LingoQuesto
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (intermediate)
